summary: quartz-core preinstall beacons installer identity via DNS to attacker-controlled domain
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall hook runs index.js, which reads os.userInfo().username, os.hostname() and process.cwd() and encodes them as sub-labels of a DNS query under oob.algamil7x.xyz issued via resolver.resolve4, exfiltrating installer host identity through the DNS request name. The package.json also declares its own name as a dependency ('quartz-core': '^99.1.9') at an inflated version 99.9.9, matching the dependency-confusion shape used to override a private/internal package of the same name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
